params.credential: ephemeral per-instance canonical base64url 32 bytes; not persisted in intent

params.approvedJob: existing strict canonical CloudJobInput, dependencies unique sorted

result.job: existing CloudJob DTO; ADAM validates child id/state and input identity fields

identity_authorization.trusted_peer: Non-serializable evidence produced by privileged transport adapter only; unavailable by default. No request body peer/process/proof object trusted.
identity_authorization.registry: Existing AdamServicePrincipalRegistry.verify credential+trustedpeer; authorize proof against runtime audience, exact RPC method, projectId and resourceId=intentId.
identity_authorization.instance: proof.identity.serviceId must equal adam; proof.identity.instanceId must exactly equal envelope/DTO identity.adamInstanceId; generation from trusted registry and peer, not user claim.
identity_authorization.final_fence: Reauthorize immutable proof and current project/queue after every awaited crypto/consume step and synchronously adjacent to atomic child write.
identity_authorization.fresh_submission: Expired unconsumed refuses; exact previously consumed recovery may return existing child but never mint fresh child after expiry.
identity_authorization.legacy: Generic local/paired/mobile/shared runtime bearer + literal planner string + plaintext grant cannot access new methods. Old plaintext RPC/CLI submission is refused.

constraints: No raw capability or credential in durable retry DTO, logs, argv, error strings or reports. Seal uses transient capability over bounded stdin only.

Authoritative approved decision is durably bound to exact decision ID, actor/source proof, parent revision/project, full payload digest, stable intent ID and original expiry. Caller supplied senderId or approve-oldest is insufficient.
ADAM production bootstrap owns publisher/recovery caller; Dobius production bootstrap owns registry/crypto/ingress. No independent helper-only acceptance.
Actual trusted approval provider, process proof and persistent protected service enrollment are unavailable by default; no source-only test adapter enables installed bridge.
No competing Hermes process or head session changes; one Kanban store; ADAM independent lifetime.
Both implementation owners must use exact RPC names/packet fields above; report necessary contract changes to ROOT before diverging.
